channel.title: Paksh: Science & Tech
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Mistral AI Launches New AI Model to Challenge Competitors
item.description: Mistral AI has unveiled a new artificial intelligence model designed to compete more effectively with leading global AI developers. The company aims to narrow the gap with top competitors, particularly those in China and the United States… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nobel Prizes Awarded for Medicine and Physics Discoveries
item.description: Three scientists were awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine for their work in optogenetics and mapping the brain, with discoveries involving blue light, green algae, and memory. Separately, the Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded for research… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: ASOS alerts customers of alleged hack through phone notification
item.description: ASOS sent a phone notification to customers warning that the retailer had been hacked; the company told recipients not to engage with the unauthorised message and said it would provide further information, and reports indicated that… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: DRDO tests indigenous high-altitude airship for surveillance
item.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully conducted a flight trial of its indigenous High-Altitude Platform (HAPS), a lighter-than-air system designed for long-endurance surveillance. The experimental flight… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Google tests AI chips in space for orbital data centers
item.description: Google has launched AI chips into space to test the feasibility of future orbital data centers. This initiative marks a significant step in exploring the potential for data processing and storage in orbit. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Coverage from Global Outlets
item.description: Global news outlets are covering Artificial Intelligence (AI), with The Economist providing analysis and the Los Angeles Times also featuring the topic. The coverage indicates a general focus on AI as a subject of news and analysis. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Saturn to Reach Opposition, Appearing Brightest Sunday
item.description: Saturn will reach its opposition on Sunday, an astronomical event where the planet will appear brightest and closest to Earth. This phenomenon is expected to be visible in various locations, including the UAE. The next time Saturn will… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Ethics Shaped by Hindu Philosophy, Debate on Consciousness
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is incorporating Hindu philosophy into the ethical framework for its AI model, Claude. This development has sparked a debate regarding the 'moral status' and consciousness of AI. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India achieves first free-space quantum communication link
item.description: India has successfully demonstrated its first free-space Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) link, spanning a distance of 5.56 kilometers. This achievement marks a significant trial in quantum-secure communication. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: AI Deciphers 217-Year-Old Napoleonic Cipher in Six Hours
item.description: Artificial intelligence has successfully deciphered a 217-year-old Napoleonic cipher from 1809, a task that had remained unsolved for over two centuries. The AI technology reportedly cracked the code in just six hours, revealing details… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US diplomats instructed to replace 'AI' with 'super intelligence' after Trump’s UN remarks
item.description: President Donald Trump, speaking at the United Nations, referred to artificial intelligence as “super intelligence.” Following the remarks, the U.S. State Department instructed American diplomats to use the term “super intelligence”… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 3.

item.title: SpaceX Starship Reaches Orbit in First Attempt, Flight Ends Early
item.description: SpaceX successfully launched its Starship rocket into orbit for the first time on Monday, deploying 23 Starlink V3 satellites. The flight, however, ended early with the rocket splashing down in a dramatic fireball. Despite the early… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 1.

item.title: AI-powered drones reshaping aerial combat experiments
item.description: The U.S. Air Force is experimenting with Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), which are AI-powered autonomous drones, in a development that is reshaping aerial combat. Similar advancements are also transforming the British Army, with AI… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Microsoft Updates Copilot with AI Coding and Agent Tools
item.description: Microsoft has updated its Copilot AI assistant, introducing a new coding tool and an "always-on" AI agent feature named "Autopilot". The revamp includes capabilities for code generation and agentic AI tools. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US and China compete in AI race, with differing strengths
item.description: The United States leads in Artificial Intelligence (AI) spending and computing power, while China is ahead in AI research and is narrowing the gap in advanced AI models. The coverage suggests a competitive dynamic between the two nations… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Museum Samples Aid Major Genetic Revision of Bat Family Tree
item.description: The Royal Ontario Museum supplied genetic samples that were incorporated into a large-scale genetic analysis, leading researchers to revise the evolutionary family tree of bats, according to reports from multiple news outlets. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: DRDO signs first major quantum tech deal with startup
item.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has signed its first high-value deep-tech project agreement under the Technology Development Fund (TDF) scheme. The deal is with a startup, Zero mK India Private Limited, to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Australian PM Warns UN on AI Pace After Medicare Breach
item.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese addressed the UN General Assembly in New York City, warning about the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence. He cited the recent AI hack of Medicare as an example necessitating stronger AI… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Zoho's Vembu Advocates AI R&D Over GPU Investment
item.description: Sridhar Vembu, Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Zoho, has stated that India should prioritize investment in foundational Artificial Intelligence (AI) research and development rather than focusing on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). Vembu… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Google to conduct first orbital test of AI chips in space
item.description: Google announced that it will conduct its first orbital test of artificial‑intelligence (AI) chips in space under a project called “Project Suncatcher.” Multiple outlets reported the plan as the first such test of AI computing hardware in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 3.

item.title: AI misuse concerns raised by Xi Jinping to Donald Trump
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping urged then-US President Donald Trump to prevent the "misuse" of artificial intelligence (AI). This call occurred during a period of bond market volatility and amidst public attention on "tech bros". Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ampace to showcase modular AI data centre power at DCWA
item.description: Ampace announced it will spotlight its modular AI data centre power solutions at the Data Center World Asia (DCWA) event, according to reports from The Wire and The Hindu BusinessLine. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: YouTube Launches AI Creator Tools and Shopping Features
item.description: YouTube announced new artificial intelligence-powered tools for creators and enhanced shopping features at its annual event. The company aims to leverage AI to assist creators in producing content and to improve the user experience for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: AI verification tools being developed amid US-China slowdown calls
item.description: Amid calls for the US and China to slow artificial intelligence development, start-ups are beginning to build tools for verifying compliance with potential agreements. Researchers and start-ups are working on technology to enable… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Breast Cancer Screening Tech Nears Final Clinical Trials
item.description: Lord's Mark is advancing its AI-powered breast cancer screening technology towards final clinical trials. These trials are planned to take place in the USA, UK, and Europe. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: AI internet takeover concerns gain urgency
item.description: Multiple news outlets reported that worries about a possible AI-driven takeover of the internet have intensified, describing it as a doomsday scenario. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
